title: cnpg-drop-node-exclusions
description:
Remove node favorites from Postgres scheduling.
File: k8s/applications/postgres.yaml (~lines 56-69, inside spec.instances cluster affinity).
DELETE the nodeAffinity requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution block (NotIn [macarm01, macintel01, rpi01]) and its comment ("Keep instances OFF the flaky roaming VMs...").
KEEP enablePodAntiAffinity: true, podAntiAffinityType: preferred, topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname (that is spread, not exclusion).
Rationale: repo rule - no node favorites or exclusions; a flaky replica on a node is fixed at the node, not banned from scheduling.
Do NOT apply anything to the cluster. Render-only validation.
ACCEPTANCE: Rendered manifest shows cluster.affinity with enablePodAntiAffinity=true + hostname topologyKey retained; zero hostname NotIn nodeSelectorTerms remain. Diff committed on branch. Evidence (render snippet) in tk comment.
